reason: Intentional DOM contract: maxlength counts UTF-16 units like the native HTML field; maxLines counts explicit LF-delimited paragraphs, independent of font readiness, host width and wrapping. Native schema instead advertises code points and displayed lines. The local headless route rejects text/compose delivery, so no faithful native user-edit comparison is available. Programmatic data writes bypass edit limits intentionally, as HTML value assignment does.
